metric_definitions.per_break_uncached_cost: uncached tokens on the break turn

per_break_uncached_cost.note: Per break event (3 sessions x 2 compaction turns = 6 per arm). cost_gross = uncached_t - (prompt_t % 64).  within_10pct compares EDIT cost to FORK cost.

window_token_imbalance.note: Imbalance between EDIT and FORK after compaction.  The library does not force the two arms to the same rendered token count; these deltas are reported as a limitation rather than normalised away.

kill_condition.rule: If per-break cost in EDIT is within 10% of FORK across all 6 break events, the 'never create the break' claim is REFUTED.

u15_decomposition_note: U15's 1.700x total-uncached ratio (R/A) does not survive decomposition: only 1620 of R's 20649-token excess over the control (7.8%) was net break cost at the two compaction turns; 19029 tokens (92.2%) was post-compaction steady-state window truncation.  G1 isolates the break cost with a constant post-compaction window; its per-break cost ratio E/F is 1.0384615384615385 and kill-condition verdict is not refuted.

claim.question: Is the per-break cost in the EDIT arm within 10% of the FORK arm across all 6 break events?
claim.statement: NOT REFUTED: per-break cost in EDIT is not within 10% of FORK across all 6 break events (2/6 within 10%) (mean gross E=1728.0, F=1664.0, ratio=1.0384615384615385). U15's 1.700x does not survive decomposition: it was 92.2% post-compaction window truncation, not break-event cost.
